data.analysis_policy: Report the piecewise-linear integral of observed transmittance over the measured wavelength range and the whole-real-line area of its fitted nonnegative Gaussian mean. The Gaussian area is height*width*sqrt(2*pi); it is a model extrapolation,not an observed integral. Fit unweighted native responses,initialheight0.35,center450,width5.
data.units: Native wavelength×transmittance area units; no conversion or calibration to energy/photons is asserted.
